coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 1 of 5 ground-truth variable items (20%): torsion-angle autocorrelation, whose cosine form is correctly identified as the real part of the complex correlation. The other required variables and settings are missing or substantially changed.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits pooling 30k test-peptide frames and the fixed training/inference settings (256-residue crops, every-40-frame subsampling, full-protein inference). Replaces the specified 100 fs reference versus 10 ps subsampled versus 100 fs MDGEN-upsampled comparison with primarily 1 fs reconstruction and multiple strides/baselines. Changes the autocorrelation lag range from 100 fs–100 ps and omits dynamic content defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion about recovered sub-ps oscillations, agreement with ground-truth autocorrelation, or non-monotonic dynamic content in MDGEN outputs versus missing fine-grained dynamics in subsampled trajectories.
